meta_description: Jill Walker is a professional painter and decorator in Newcastle. Expert interior and exterior painting, competitive quotes, local and reliable.
hero_subhead: From tired walls to beautifully finished rooms. Jill brings 15 years of expertise to every project in Newcastle and the surrounding areas.
services_heading: Interior and Exterior Painting Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: Whether it's a single room refresh or a full property transformation, Jill delivers professional results on time and on budget.

services.title: Interior Painting and Decorating
services.desc: Complete room transformations including walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls. Jill prepares all surfaces properly and uses premium paints to ensure a lasting finish that transforms your space.

services.title: Exterior Painting and Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior finishes for walls, fascias, doors, and gates. Jill works with quality exterior paints designed to withstand Newcastle's climate and protect your property for years to come.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging and Removal
services.desc: Expert wallpaper installation, pattern matching, and careful removal of old coverings. Jill prepares walls to perfection and hangs wallpaper with precision—no bubbles, no wrinkles, just a professional finish.

services.title: Woodwork and Door Painting
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, architraves, and window frames restored to pristine condition. Jill uses specialist primers and finishes to handle wood properly, whether refreshing existing paint or creating a bold new colour.

services.title: Bathroom and Kitchen Decoration
services.desc: Moisture-resistant painting solutions for kitchens and bathrooms. Jill understands the unique challenges these rooms present and applies specialist products to prevent peeling and mildew in high-humidity environments.

services.title: Commercial and Property Maintenance
services.desc: Reliable painting and maintenance for rental properties, commercial spaces, and landlord refresh projects. Jill works efficiently to minimise disruption and keep properties looking smart.

about_pullquote: I take pride in doing the job right the first time—no shortcuts, no excuses.
about_para_1: Jill Walker has been decorating homes and businesses across Newcastle for over 15 years. What started as a passion for creating beautiful spaces has grown into a trusted reputation built on reliability, attention to detail, and genuine customer care. She trained in traditional decoration techniques and has kept pace with modern paint systems and finishes, ensuring every project benefits from both timeless craft and contemporary products.
about_para_2: Customers return to Jill because she listens, prepares properly, and delivers consistently. She treats every project—whether a small cloakroom or a full house redecoration—with the same professionalism and respect. Her commitment to turning up on time, protecting your furnishings, and leaving your home spotless has earned her a steady stream of repeat business and personal recommendations across Newcastle.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Customers Say About Jill

reviews.text: Jill painted our front room and hallway last spring. She was punctual, kept everything tidy, and the finish is absolutely immaculate. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend her—fantastic job at a fair price.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Had our kitchen redecorated with specialist paint to handle the moisture. Three years on and it still looks fresh. Jill's professionalism and care for detail really shows in her work.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Needed our rental property freshened up quickly before new tenants arrived. Jill turned it round in three days without rushing—walls perfect, no mess left behind. Will be calling her again.
reviews.author: Claire W.
